task_authority: User requests nominal shared algorithms, eliminate runtime data-preparation overhead and preserve source/CP semantics.
corpus: 702 modules / 5110 original ClassDefs / 5098 projected / 12 retained OPEN, complete original census before editing.
domain: File-format-owned immutable header facts for a physical source revision.
measured_dominant_term: 780 header reads over three physical files: 0.494 seconds out of 1.589 seconds source loading plus side-artifact materialization. Saved physical-file replay 0.383285 -> 0.003932 seconds for balanced 780 reads.
maximum_payoff: Approximately 0.49 seconds per representative 3D well; removes about 31% of remaining source-preparation cost. Header parsing grows with planes/repeated readers; reuse requires no pixel retention. This does not close the whole execution gap.

determining_owners.file_revision: ImageFileRevision derived from OS stat path/device/inode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns
determining_owners.reuse_and_failure_lifecycle: ImageFileFormat.require_source_metadata shared bounded cache; only successful reads cache, exceptions are not cached
determining_owners.parsing: ImageFileFormat._read_source_metadata concrete class hooks; existing TIFF single-container logic and NumPy loader remain exact

required_pairs: Every registered format inherits the revision/cache algorithm
Concrete parsing hooks are class methods, determined by format declarations and file input, not transient format instances

forbidden_pairs: reuse across changed file revisions or changed parsing hooks
consumers: existing TIFF declared-scale and pixel-semantics callers
counterevidence: Formats are currently stateless declarations: no source header reader uses instance-owned data. Changing readers to class hooks makes this explicit.

Stat fingerprints do not promise atomic reads during concurrent mutation; preserve current source-reader concurrency scope.
